top_findings.title: Only 2 test functions; spec requires at least 3
top_findings.evidence: tests/test_api.py defines only test_health (line 7) and test_crud_book (line 14); pytest --collect-only reports exactly 2 collected items. TASK.md deliverable and REQUIREMENTS.json R12 require >= 3 unit/integration tests. Confirmed on re-check (second opinion).
top_findings.suggestion: Split test_crud_book into per-operation tests (create, get, list-filter, update, delete, 404) or add a validation test so >= 3 tests collect.
